facts.claim: In March 1870 there were 1,545 pupils at the school, of which 1,422 were in Government Schools and 1,082 were children of Coorgs.
facts.quote: Of the 1,545 pupils at School in March 1870, 1,422 were in Government Schools and 1,082 children Coorgs.

facts.claim: There was roughly one child at school for every 78 people in the whole population, about 13 per thousand.
facts.quote: of one child at school for every 78 people of the whole population or nearly 13 per thousand;

facts.claim: In religious matters the Coorg rulers displayed a tolerant and liberal spirit that shamed many Christian governments.
facts.quote: in religious matters they showed a tolerant and liberal spirit, which at the time put to shame the intolerance of many Christian Governments.
